description: Use verb-noun format for scenarios and acceptance criteria. Example: 'User submits form' (verb-noun), not 'Form submission' (noun-only).

do.description: Use verb-noun format with base verb forms. Example: 'User submits order', 'System validates payment', 'Select item from list'

guidance.description: Use verb-noun format for scenario sentences
Use verb-noun format for acceptance criteria
Use base verb forms (infinitive/imperative), not third-person singular

dont.description: Don't use noun-only, gerund, or third-person singular verb forms. Example: 'Form submission' (noun-only), 'Submitting form' (gerund), 'Selects item' (third-person)

guidance.description: Don't use noun-only or capability-based names for scenarios
Don't use third-person singular verb forms
